errors.einvoice_not_awaiting: This submission is not awaiting an answer from the DIAN.
errors.invoice_not_issued: Only an issued invoice is sent to the DIAN.
errors.poll_limit: The DIAN did not answer in time. «Retry submission» polls the same submission again, without resending it.
errors.cufe_changed: The document no longer matches the issued invoice's CUFE: correct it with a note; it is not resent.
errors.document_changed: The invoice's stored amounts do not add up: its electronic document cannot be built; it is corrected with a note.
errors.currency_not_supported: The invoice's currency is not in the DIAN's currency table: its electronic document cannot be built.
errors.submission_in_doubt: The previous send may have reached the DIAN and its tracking number is unknown: check it on the DIAN portal.
errors.credentials_missing: The digital certificate or the software PIN is missing: upload them in Invoicing settings.
errors.invoice_rejected: The DIAN rejected this invoice: correct it and use «Retry submission». A note or an annulment only corrects an invoice the DIAN accepted.
errors.invoice_not_sent: This invoice has not been sent to the DIAN yet: a note or an annulment only corrects an invoice the DIAN accepted.
errors.invoice_send_failed: This invoice's submission to the DIAN stopped: use «Retry submission» and wait for the DIAN to accept it.
errors.invoice_not_accepted: This invoice is on its way to the DIAN: wait for it to be accepted before issuing a note or annulling it.
errors.invoice_voided: This invoice is voided: it takes no more notes.
errors.invoice_has_note: This invoice already has a credit or debit note: it is not annulled again.
errors.note_references_note: A note corrects an invoice, never another note: name the sales invoice.
errors.credit_exceeds_invoice: The credit note exceeds what is left of the invoice (its total plus debit notes, less credit notes).
errors.invalid_note_line: A line of the note does not belong to the invoice or asks for more than was invoiced.
errors.invalid_note_concept: The correction concept is not one of the DIAN's table for that note type.
errors.annulment_by_void: An invoice is annulled with «Void» on the invoice, which issues the full annulment credit note.
errors.note_not_voidable: A note issued before the DIAN is not voided: it is corrected by another note.
errors.note_not_issued: Only an issued note is sent to the DIAN.
errors.cude_changed: The note's document no longer matches the CUDE of its first submission: correct it with another note.
errors.nothing_to_note: The note has no lines or value: name the invoice lines it corrects.
errors.note_draft_delete: This note is a draft: delete it instead of voiding it.
errors.note_issued: This note has already been issued.
errors.note_not_sent: This note has no DIAN submission yet: wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.annulment_invoice_not_issued: The DIAN accepted the annulment note, but the invoice is no longer issued (for example, it was paid meanwhile): review it with support.
errors.no_sequence: The company has no numbering for this kind of note: register it in Core › Settings › Document sequences (prefix and next number; notes carry no DIAN resolution).
errors.dian_checklist_incomplete: Values are still unverified in the DIAN checklist: the confirmation needs every one ticked
errors.dian_in_production: The company is in production: the verification is not withdrawn. Go back to habilitación to untick values
errors.dian_defaults_unconfirmed: The electronic document defaults are not confirmed: verify the DIAN checklist before going to production
errors.exchange_rate_missing: There is no exchange rate for the document currency on its date: record it in Exchange rates or type it on the document
errors.invalid_exchange_rate: A document in the company currency carries no exchange rate (it is 1)
errors.foreign_currency_domestic: In this version only export invoices can be in a foreign currency

own_flags.requires_approval: Needs no approval: a note is issued with «Issue».
